title: The job market is absolutely disgusting - I'm doing something about it!
why_read: A personal rant and pitch about fixing the job market, light on technical content and more of a startup idea announcement.
analysis: This post is a first-person account of frustration with hiring practices (onsite requirements, disability accommodations, resume formats) followed by a pitch to 'flip' the hiring model, without concrete technical detail yet provided. It reads as an early-stage idea solicitation rather than a technical article, with no architecture, code, or implementation discussion included in the excerpt. It may be of interest to people following indie-hacker project launches but offers little for engineers seeking technical substance.
